source.note: The recovered prototype combines family profiles, parent approvals, tasks, rewards, messages, streaks and learning with simulated token-price, wallet-address and staking language. LarriVerse preserves the family system while replacing the pretend-finance layer.

boundaries.pinNote: The parent PIN is a convenience lock on this browser, not strong account security.
